items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: There was a New Orleans trumpet player around at that time called Sugar Johnny Smith

ctx.x: No, I couldn't get close enough. And Mr. & Mrs. Mullins, they said, "Oh, let's get out of here, it's so smokey," and everything else. But I always tried to find out who he was. He was a good trumpet player.
There was a New Orleans trumpet player around at that time called Sugar Johnny Smith, and there was George Mitchell.
